stories.text: Homer Bailey of the Cincinnati Reds no-hits the Pittsburgh Pirates 1–0 at PNC Park. He strikes out 10 batters in pitching the seventh no-hitter of this season, which ties 1990 and 1991 for most no-hitters in one modern-day season. The no-hitter is the first by a Red since Tom Browning's perfect game in 1988, and the first against the Pirates since St. Louis' Bob Gibson in 1971.
stories.headline: Bailey No-Hits Pirates 1-0 at PNC Park, 7th No-Hitter This Season
